note: Chemistry round 3: four data passages (titration, rate data, electrode potentials, solubility) and applied/calculation items across the JAMB syllabus.

passages.title: Titration of sodium trioxocarbonate(IV) with hydrochloric acid
passages.text:
25.0 cm³ portions of a solution of sodium
trioxocarbonate(IV), Na₂CO₃, were titrated
with 0.10 mol/dm³ hydrochloric acid using
methyl orange as indicator. The burette
readings are shown below. (Na = 23,
C = 12, O = 16)

Titration          1      2      3
Final (cm³)     25.60  49.90  25.10
Initial (cm³)    0.00  25.00   0.00
Titre (cm³)     25.60  24.90  25.10

passages.title: Rate of reaction of magnesium with dilute acid
passages.text:
A piece of magnesium ribbon was dropped
into excess dilute hydrochloric acid at
25 °C and the volume of hydrogen collected
was recorded every 20 seconds.

Time (s)        0   20   40   60   80  100
Volume (cm³)    0   30   50   62   68   68

passages.title: Standard electrode potentials of some metals
passages.text:
The standard electrode potentials of some
metals are given below.

Electrode         E°/V
Mg²⁺/Mg          -2.37
Zn²⁺/Zn          -0.76
Fe²⁺/Fe          -0.44
Cu²⁺/Cu          +0.34
Ag⁺/Ag           +0.80

passages.text:
The solubility of potassium
trioxonitrate(V), KNO₃, in water at
different temperatures is shown below.
(KNO₃ = 101)

Temp (°C)              20   40   60   80
Solubility             32   64  110  169
